lines: The final gate is still running in its own sandbox: at 23:21 it had G1 to G12 passed and G13 running; its limit is 00:25

Open item 218 followed up, as a check and not a change: with reduced motion set, a press on the frozen build does finish at phone size, winter to spring, no lift and no shake, the controls back on; it took 226 seconds on this machine's software drawing, and the same check at 1280 x 720 is running
The fresh review stands at 6 of 10 with nine must-fixes (decision 127); nothing is mended before the stop
Sound, read 23:36: 6,765 of the 10,000 credits used in 40 paid calls, 3,235 left, none planned
